revisions.statement: A 16-state, four-input F450 hover LTI plant includes 450 mm nominal diagonal, 159.099 mm roll/pitch lever, motor lag and translational drag. Physical parameters are assumed; numerical continuous and exact held-input plant matrices are generated.

revisions.statement: For the documented assumed plant and ideal state feedback, rounded C gains give stable continuous and 2 ms sampled loops. Largest sampled pole magnitudes: roll/pitch 0.994932, yaw 0.993840, height 0.998631. This excludes actual delay, estimator dynamics and saturation.
revisions.reason: Added for the requested emulation, organization and linear model work.

revisions.statement: Schema 2 stores stable facts, append-only dated revisions, typed sources, evidence levels and dependency relations. SQLite FTS5 is a disposable cache; validation, hash freshness, build locking and atomic replacement protect integrity. Nine isolated failure-containment/search checks pass.
revisions.reason: Added for the requested emulation, organization and linear model work.
